entry.title: New: Resolution 409 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A QUITCLAIM OF REAL PROPERTY, BEING A PORTION OF GOVERNMENT HOMESTEAD ROAD AND A 30-FOOT-WIDE RIGHT OF WAY, SITUATED AT HONOMŪ, SOUTH HILO, ISLAND OF HAWAIʻI, STATE OF HAWAIʻI, BY ITS BOARD OF LAND AND NATURAL RESOURCES

The County seeks to preserve and protect public access to the Hilo Forest Reserve.
